doc.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009

chapter: Jazz, Lincoln Center and the music market
title: Wrapping up the interview
summary: Rowe thanks him, both look forward to the performance, and Christopher thanks him for the chance to meet students.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been fascinating talking to you.
Thanks, Monk, I had a good time.
I look forward to what happens on the bandstand.
It’s like one of my favorite subjects, clarinet, Kenny and music.
Well thanks for the opportunity to hang out with some of the kids, it was good. I have to make a habit of it. I’ve got to get some other New Orleans guys up here.
